button.reason: Button owns spec-derived anatomy, contract, guidelines, state, and responsive examples that predate the shared data renderer.
button.migrationRule: Keep only while each section is wrapped by componentDetailSection and continues using Flow demos for examples.

card.reason: Card documents composition scenarios, reference compositions, and stats/list card layouts that are not equivalent to the shared demo grid.
card.migrationRule: Keep only while section containers use componentDetailSection and nested examples remain Card demos or neutral layout primitives.

checkbox.reason: Checkbox has choice-state matrices and playground wiring that share data conventions but need component-specific demo transforms.
checkbox.migrationRule: Prefer shared panels when parity is possible; custom sections must keep componentDetailSection.

combobox.reason: Combobox combines shared panels with custom operational, accessibility, and playground copy for queryable option behavior.
combobox.migrationRule: Keep as hybrid only; any new custom section must declare why shared renderSimpleGoldSection is insufficient.

icon-button.reason: Icon Button has selected, badged, density, and icon-only state examples that require component-specific transforms.
icon-button.migrationRule: Keep only while examples render through Flow IconButton demos and section containers use componentDetailSection.

input.reason: Input owns field semantics, mono/suffix/icon states, and playground transforms that should not leak into the generic renderer.
input.migrationRule: Keep until Field/Form primitives absorb those transforms; custom sections must stay Flow-surface wrapped.

radio-button.reason: Radio Button owns selected/choice-state examples and transforms distinct from Checkbox despite shared choice foundations.
radio-button.migrationRule: Keep only while sections use componentDetailSection and demos render through Flow RadioButton.

select.reason: Select owns option-layer, trigger/value/helper behavior, and playground transforms that are not identical to Input.
select.migrationRule: Keep until Select Option Layer and Field governance can absorb the custom examples.

switch.reason: Switch owns on/off operational state and density transforms distinct from Checkbox and Radio Button.
switch.migrationRule: Keep only while sections use componentDetailSection and demos render through Flow Switch.

text-area.reason: Text Area owns rows, max length, helper, and long-form field examples that require custom demo transforms.
text-area.migrationRule: Keep until Field/Form governance supports the full text-area contract.
